company.description: Company name. Fixtures use synthetic names only.

brief.description: Path to Brief file, relative to the package directory.

cv.description: Path to role-specific CV file, relative to the package directory.

cl.description: Path to cover letter file. Cannot be omitted or waived.

profile_url.description: Live company Profile URL: https://ai.drsfilms.com/{company}/ — not a homepage.

vi.description: Optional path to VI distill record (required for hop R-VI).

waivers.description: FORBIDDEN for profile and cover letter. Field exists so the harness can detect and REJECT it. Nobody may waive Profile or CL.

company_aliases.description: Optional documented shortenings of this company legal name. Trusted only when they are a whole token or hyphen-boundary prefix of company, or a built-in legal-name map entry. Prefix collisions inside a longer token (Metaphor + meta) and arbitrary foreign slugs (Meta + aliases: cloudflare + /cloudflare/) are ignored.

compared_to.description: The current visual bar: the newest 3 shipped public/{company}/index.html routes (excluding this package company), by last git commit timestamp (mtime if git is unavailable). r2-profile-recent-bar ACCEPT only when this array matches that set. A frozen pair (elevenlabs+luma, wonder+kalshi) is REJECT when newer pages exist.
